description: Fetch any public URL (HTML article, PDF, JSON) and return clean JSON matching YOUR schema in one call. No scraping code, no parsing: give a url and the fields you want. Input: url, schema (field -> type/description). Output: data + page title + source. Costs $0.03 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base or Solana). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/extract-url with an x402 client.

max_chars.description: Max characters read from the document (1,000 to 60,000)

url.description: Public URL of an article, PDF or JSON document

name: extract_url
